svg.text: The journey of one message — and every point it could be lost
Nine hops from spacecraft to queryable row. Three carry real risk; one loses data on purpose.
Producer builds the event
event_id generated once, here. Reused on every resend — this is the
entire basis of deduplication downstream.
LOSS POSSIBLE
On-board buffer overflow during an extended blackout.
Bounded FIFO, oldest evicted. The one place we knowingly discard.
Client publishes to Pub/Sub
Payload plus attributes: ground_station_id, event_id, satellite_id.
The station adds its own identity; the satellite cannot know it.
LOSS POSSIBLE
The client batches asynchronously. An instance terminating with
unflushed batches loses them. Mitigation: flush on SIGTERM.
Pub/Sub accepts and persists
Durable and replicated the moment the publish future resolves.
Seven-day retention makes replay possible at all.
NO LOSS BY DESIGN
Nothing is lost here. This is the one hop you can genuinely stop
worrying about.
Subscription delivers to Dataflow
At-least-once. Redelivery after the 60-second ack deadline is normal
behaviour, not an error condition.
NO LOSS BY DESIGN
After 5 failed attempts a message moves to the dead-letter topic,
where a hold subscription retains it for inspection.
Pipeline decodes and writes raw
Written unconditionally, before any parsing is attempted, with a
SHA-256 of the original bytes.
NO LOSS BY DESIGN
Even undecodable bytes are preserved. If raw only accepted
parseable messages it would not be raw.
Validation classifies the record
Schema, types, plausibility bounds, timestamp sanity. Implausible is
not the same as abnormal — see the design notes.
NO LOSS BY DESIGN
Every rejection becomes a quarantine row with a reason code
and offending field. No path exits the DoFn without emitting.
Deduplication suppresses repeats
Keyed on the producer-supplied event_id, never on derived ingestion
metadata. 60-minute processing-time state window.
DELIBERATE LOSS
Repeat copies are dropped from curated on purpose — and are still
recorded in raw — a repeat delivery is a fact about the world.
Event-time windowing
Fixed 60-second windows on event time, 45 minutes allowed lateness
to cover the ground-station-3 delivery constraint.
NO LOSS BY DESIGN
Rows are written per element regardless of window. Windows bound
aggregate membership only; late rows land flagged, not discarded.
BigQuery insert makes it queryable
Streaming inserts with retry on transient error. The row is now
visible to mission operations.
LOSS POSSIBLE — KNOWN GAP
A persistently failing insert. Closing this means capturing the
sink’s FAILED_ROWS output into the quarantine table.
Reconciliation:
raw = curated + quarantined + duplicates suppressed.
If those numbers do not add up, one of the nine hops above is losing data — and the query that proves it is in the deployment guide.
